program: Wingless training-only signal factorial for future-data learning efficiency
question: Which preregistered native training signal, if any, tracks cumulative equal-budget adaptation gain when the R10 first-gain metric saturates?
hypothesis: Replay the exact three R10 leave-one-domain-out arms, 15,819-byte non-target budgets, fixed 256-motif capacity, 1,454-byte target windows, 872-byte adaptation streams, eight 109-byte cumulative packets, and 582-byte sealed evaluation suffixes. Freeze three training-only signals before target bytes are opened: (H) representation_headroom = eligible 4-byte motifs with occurrence>=4 minus 256; (D) class_support_deficit = 1 - minimum/maximum total occurrence mass across eight fixed 32-motif frequency-ranked classes; (M) relation_margin_median = median byte-relation top1-minus-runner probability margin over training rows with total support>=4. The frozen outcome is cumulative_adaptation_gain = sum over packets 1..8 of (packet exact hits - packet0 exact hits); final_gain is recorded secondarily. Test all three signals, not a post-result-selected subset. Prespecified directions: higher H predicts higher cumulative gain; higher D predicts lower cumulative gain; higher M predicts higher cumulative gain. Pairwise ties are neutral. This is signal attribution only; it cannot allocate data, change capacity, or retain a mechanism.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; optimize unseen-future-data learning efficiency under fixed budgets

prior_evidence.interpretation: First-gain saturates at one packet for all three domains, so it cannot discriminate learning efficiency. R11 changes the outcome metric prospectively only through its frozen successor preregistration; R10 itself is not retuned.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

D.name: class_support_deficit
D.definition: 1 - min(class occurrence mass)/max(class occurrence mass), eight 32-motif classes ranked by training motif occurrence

M.name: relation_margin_median
M.definition: median (top1_count-runner_count)/row_total over training byte-relation rows with row_total>=4

outcome.pairwise_test: for each signal separately, count concordant, reversed, and tied arm pairs under the prespecified direction

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and at least one preregistered signal has at least two concordant non-tied pairwise comparisons and zero reversals against cumulative adaptation gain.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and at least one signal has a concordant comparison, but no signal satisfies the supported criterion because of reversals or ties.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes and no signal has a concordant non-tied comparison.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, budget, split, signal definition/direction, R10 replay identity, target isolation, determinism, capacity, provenance, or qualification criterion fails.

successor_if_supported.intent: test a frozen fixed-total-data allocation policy driven by the supported training-only signal against equal allocation on multiple future arms; no self-modification

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: stop signal selection and directly characterize why adaptation curves differ under fixed budgets before proposing an allocation policy

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter R10 data/budgets/splits/capacity, H/D/M definitions or directions, cumulative-gain outcome, pairwise test, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.
